arxiv-2103-12401.title: Vanishing of cohomology and parameter rigidity of actions of solvable Lie groups
arxiv-2103-12401.creator: Hirokazu Maruhashi
arxiv-2103-12401.description: Abstract We give a sufficient condition for parameter rigidity of actions of solvable Lie groups, by vanishing of (uncountably many) first cohomologies of the orbit foliations. In some cases, we can prove that vanishing of finitely many cohomologies is sufficient. For this purpose we use a rigidity property of quasiisometry.

arxiv-2104-07615.title: Spatially covariant gravity with two degrees of freedom: perturbative analysis
arxiv-2104-07615.creator: Yu-Min Hu, Xian Gao
arxiv-2104-07615.description: Abstract We revisit the problem of building the Lagrangian of a large class of metric theories that respect spatial covariance, which propagate at most two degrees of freedom and in particular no scalar mode. The Lagrangians are polynomials built of the spatially covariant geometric quantities.

arxiv-2110-05126.title: Discrimination of coherent and incoherent cathodoluminescence using temporal photon correlations
arxiv-2110-05126.creator: Michael Scheucher, Thomas Schachinger, Thomas Spielauer, Michael Stöger-Pollach, Philipp Haslinger
arxiv-2110-05126.description: Abstract We present a method to separate coherent and incoherent contributions of cathodoluminescence (CL) by using a time-resolved coincidence detection scheme. For a proof-of-concept experiment, we generate CL by irradiating an optical multimode fiber with relativistic electrons in a transmission electron microscope.

arxiv-2301-00587.title: Global Optimization of Mixed-Integer Nonlinear Programs with SCIP 8
arxiv-2301-00587.creator: Ksenia Bestuzheva, Antonia Chmiela, Benjamin Müller, Felipe Serrano, Stefan Vigerske, Fabian Wegscheider
arxiv-2301-00587.description: Abstract For over ten years, the constraint integer programming framework SCIP has been extended by capabilities for the solution of convex and nonconvex mixed-integer nonlinear programs (MINLPs). With the recently published version 8.0, these capabilities have been largely reworked and extended.

arxiv-2305-09179.title: Ortho-ODE: Enhancing Robustness and of Neural ODEs against Adversarial Attacks
arxiv-2305-09179.creator: Vishal Purohit
arxiv-2305-09179.description: Abstract Neural Ordinary Differential Equations (NODEs) proposed in the influential work [ 5 ] , probed the usage of numerical solvers to solve the differential equation characterized by a Neural Network(NN), therefore initiating a new paradigm of deep learning models with infinite depth. NODEs were designed to tackle the irregular time series problem.

arxiv-2409-16705.title: Inclusive and diffractive neutrino-nucleus scattering at high energy
arxiv-2409-16705.creator: Anh Dung Le, Heikki Mäntysaari
arxiv-2409-16705.description: Abstract We calculate the energy dependence of inclusive and diffractive neutrino-nucleus deep-inelastic scattering cross sections within the dipole picture, focusing on the ultra-high-energy regime. We predict an up to ∼ 10 % \sim 10\% nuclear suppression in the inclusive neutrino-Oxygen scattering originating from the non-linear QCD dynamics in the small- x x Balitsky-Kovchegov evolution.

Simons, Dangka Shylla, William J. Watterson, Charles Patrick, Adil Meraki, Rajavardhan Talashila, Amanda Younes, David S. La M

Artusio-Glimpse, Samuel Berweger, Matthew T. Simons, Dangka Shylla, William J. Watterson, Charles Patrick, Adil Meraki, Rajavardhan Talashila, Amanda Younes, David S. La M. Rydberg states of alkali atoms are highly sensitive to electromagnetic radiation in the GHz-to-THz regime because their transitions have large electric dipole moments. Consequently, environmental blackbody radiation (BBR) can couple Rydberg states together at μ \mu s timescales.

arxiv-2504-01266.title: GigaAPI for GPU Parallelization
arxiv-2504-01266.creator: Mihir Suvarna, Omeed Tehrani
arxiv-2504-01266.description: Abstract . GigaAPI is a user-space API that simplifies multi-GPU programming, bridging the gap between the capabilities of parallel GPU systems and the ability of developers to harness their full potential. The API offers a comprehensive set of functionalities, including fundamental GPU operations, image processing, and complex GPU tasks, abstracting away the intricacies of low-level CUDA and C++ programming.

pmc-12386597.title: New Frontiers in 3D Printing Using Biocompatible Polymers
pmc-12386597.creator: Nagireddy Poluri, Jacob Carter, John Grasso, Walter Miller, Matthew Leinbach, Frederick Durant, Riley Benbrook, Assa John, Allan Wang, Xiao Hu
pmc-12386597.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Biocompatible polymers have emerged as essential materials in medical 3D printing, enabling the fabrication of scaffolds, tissue constructs, drug delivery systems, and biosensors for applications in and on the human body. This review aims to provide a comprehensive overview of the current state of 3D-printable biocompatible polymers and their composites, with an emphasis on their processing methods, properties, and biomedical uses.

pmc-12546858.title: Myeloid-derived suppressor cells inhibit the replication of oncolytic virus by reducing intratumoral arginine levels
pmc-12546858.creator: Parker Dryja, Erica B Flores, Mee Y Bartee, Viswanathan Palanisamy, Eric Bartee
pmc-12546858.description: Oncolytic virotherapy uses replication-competent viruses to treat various solid tumors. While much of the clinical efficacy of oncolytic virotherapy is mediated by anti-tumor T cell responses, most of these therapies still rely on the in vivo replication of the viral agents within infected tumor cells.

pmc-13194610.title: The H3K9me2-FOXG1-microRNA axis reduces cochlear hair cells damage by modulating autophagy in age-related hearing loss
pmc-13194610.creator: Sihui Wen, Yongping Huang, Yurong Mu, Caini Li, Bowen Xu, Shengyu Zou, Chunjiang Wei, Kun Lin, Tingting Wu, Peng Zhang, Zuhong He
pmc-13194610.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Age-related hearing loss (ARHL) is a growing global health concern due to its irreversibility and multifactorial pathogenesis. Epigenetic alterations are emerging as key drivers of aging, yet the mechanisms underlying their contribution to ARHL remain poorly understood. Here, we identified the histone H3 lysine 9 dimethylation (H3K9me2)-forkhead box G1 (FOXG1)-microRNA axis as a crucial regulator of auditory degeneration through modulation of autophagy.

pmc-13311181.title: Comparative hematological and serum biochemical profiling of grassland Xichun and Xilingol horses
pmc-13311181.creator: Tugeqin Bou, Wenqi Ding, Wendian Gong, Zheng Li, Xiaoyuan Shi, Manglai Dugarjaviin, Dongyi Bai, Lihua Yang
pmc-13311181.description: The Grassland Xichun horse is an emerging crossbred population developed from Xilingol mares and Thoroughbred stallions in Inner Mongolia, China, yet its blood physiological profile has not been systematically characterized. In this study, we compared 32 hematological and serum biochemical parameters between 177 Grassland Xichun horses and 35 Xilingol horses maintained under the same extensive grazing conditions.

pmc-13357055.title: Bioengineered Exosome-Magnetic Nanoplatform for Precision Therapy of Hepatocellular Carcinoma via Dual-Targeted Drug Delivery
pmc-13357055.creator: Yongsheng Han, Shixian Yan, Ruohan Wan, Xingjing Li, Guanlin Wu
pmc-13357055.description: IntroductionHepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) continues to pose a significant threat to global health, contributing substantially to worldwide cancer-related mortality, particularly in high-incidence regions such as Asia, where current treatment strategies are often limited by poor drug delivery efficiency, systemic toxicity, and drug resistance.

pmc-13450507.title: Integrating rain classroom with case-based learning in teaching dental hard tissue non-carious diseases: a comparative study
pmc-13450507.creator: Yu Bo, Zou Huiru, Li Mohan
pmc-13450507.description: BackgroundDental hard tissue non-carious diseases pose a growing clinical challenge, yet traditional lecture-based dental education often fails to effectively teach their complex diagnosis and management. Considering the limitations of conventional methods in engaging students and promoting practical application, this study explored the potential of integrating Rain Classroom with Case-based Learning (CBL) to enhance teaching effectiveness.

pmc-13471403.title: Alkylating agents activate an SLFN11-dependent vulnerability that confers PARP-1 inhibitor sensitivity in kidney cancer
pmc-13471403.creator: Chenliang Wang, Ming Zhu, Lei Bao, Vanina Toffessi Tcheuyap, James Brugarolas, Weibo Luo, Yingfei Wang
pmc-13471403.description: BackgroundPARP inhibitors have demonstrated notable clinical benefit, particularly in tumors with BRCA1/2 mutations. Clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC) carrying wild type (WT) BRCA1/2 is resistant to PARP inhibitor monotherapy. Strategies to enhance the sensitivity of BRCA1/2-WT ccRCC to PARP inhibitors remain challenging.

pmc-13519169.title: Machine learning approaches to identify influential factors associated with hypertension and prehypertension among rural adults in Bangladesh
pmc-13519169.creator: Md Zahidul Islam, Mohammad Rocky Khan Chowdhury, Zarin Raihana, Farzana Akhter Bornee, Farah Naz Rahman, Shanta Rani Biswas, Mamunur Rashid
pmc-13519169.description: BackgroundHypertension poses a significant public health challenge in Bangladesh, particularly among rural populations with limited access to healthcare. Thus, this study aimed to identify the influential factors associated with hypertension and prehypertension in rural Bangladesh using sophisticated machine learning (ML) methods.MethodsA total of 1603 respondents were selected in this study using a multistage random sampling from a cross-sectional survey.
